title: Travel Protection Plans: Terms on Giving Up Cover and on Upgrading
content:
These are the terms on which a Travel Protection Plans policyholder may give up cover or move to a higher plan. The free-look period is the number of calendar days after issue in which the policy may be cancelled for a full refund. The free-look refund share is the percentage of premium returned on such a cancellation. The mid-term share is the percentage of unearned premium returned on a cancellation after that period. The commission clawback is the percentage of the agency's commission recovered when a policy is cancelled inside the free-look period. The upgrade window is the number of calendar days after issue within which an upgrade may be requested, on the plans that permit one.

| Plan | Free-look period, days | Free-look refund, per cent | Mid-term share of unearned premium, per cent | Commission clawback, per cent | Upgrade permitted | Upgrade window, days |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Trip Basics Essential | 10 | 100 | 0 | 100 | yes | 14 |
| Trip Basics Standard | 10 | 100 | 0 | 100 | yes | 14 |
| TripGuard Plus | 14 | 100 | 25 | 100 | yes | 14 |
| TripGuard Premier | 14 | 100 | 50 | 100 | no | 0 |
| Cancel For Any Reason Elite | 15 | 100 | 50 | 100 | no | 0 |
| Annual Multi-Trip Traveller | 15 | 100 | 60 | 100 | yes | 21 |
| Annual Multi-Trip Executive | 21 | 100 | 75 | 100 | no | 0 |

## Notes on the figures

The free-look refund share is 100 on every plan, and the commission clawback is likewise 100 on every plan.

A mid-term share of 0 stands on Trip Basics Essential and Trip Basics Standard. Above those two the share rises with the plan: 25 on TripGuard Plus, 50 on TripGuard Premier and on Cancel For Any Reason Elite, 60 on Annual Multi-Trip Traveller and 75 on Annual Multi-Trip Executive.

An upgrade window of 0 stands on the three plans that do not permit an upgrade. Where an upgrade is permitted the window is 14 calendar days on Trip Basics Essential, Trip Basics Standard and TripGuard Plus, and 21 calendar days on Annual Multi-Trip Traveller.
